name: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shapes shown while content loads, with a subtle shimmer.

classes.ayy-skeleton: Block placeholder. Set its size to match the content.

default.looks: Loading is its only look: a wash-hover block with a quiet shimmer that stops under reduced motion.

error.none: Replace Skeletons with an Alert and a retry when loading fails.

loading.when: always; set aria-busy="true" on the region it fills and aria-hidden on the skeletons
loading.looks: Shimmers. Forced colours: a dashed outline instead.

sizes.width: Size it like the content it stands in for. block fills the width at 1rem tall; text is 0.75em tall; circle is 2.5rem (an avatar).

a11y: Skeletons are aria-hidden. Put aria-busy="true" on the container while loading, and remove it when content arrives. To name the loading region, give it role="status" and an aria-label — aria-label on a plain div is ignored.
do: Use a skeleton for content that takes more than ~300ms and has a predictable layout (cards, lists, profile headers).
Match the real layout closely so nothing jumps when content arrives.
dont: Don't use skeletons for unknown layouts or long jobs — use Progress.
Don't use skeletons for instant loads — skeletons that flash are worse than nothing.
Don't show skeletons for errors or empty states.
